verdict.rationale: First-party docs state LM Studio serves local models on OpenAI-like endpoints, locally and on the network. A CLI exposes `lms server start`/`lms load`, and on-demand loading serves any requested model. Community users independently confirm the OpenAI-compatible server makes it easy to spin up and test models. missing for 10: detailed documentation in the pack of the specific OpenAI endpoint coverage (e.g., which routes and parameters are compatible).
